text: Bitcoin's modest pullback of 1.2% alongside Ethereum's smaller 0.6% decline suggests measured profit-taking rather than panic, with Bitcoin's dominance holding firm at 58.9% indicating confidence in the leading asset. The Fear & Greed index sitting at 69 (Greed) with flat weekly momentum reflects a market that remains optimistic but not overheated, supported by $80B in daily volume showing sustained participation. Altcoins show mixed signals—BNB outpacing both majors while Solana underperforms—pointing to selective rotation rather than broad risk-off sentiment.
